summary: Reviewed the complete intake and v0.3.35 release delta after 44 focused tests and the evidence-isolated smoke gate. Outcome coverage is enforced, assessment adapters cannot mutate the target, all actions are prevalidated before writes, intake authority is claim-gated without changing legacy manual claims, and model identity is reported only as requested/unconfirmed. Version, stack pin, pairing manifest, changelog and release note agree. No blocking implementation, scope, provenance, authority, compatibility-baseline or release-readiness finding remains.
